speaker: Mr Yee Chia Hsing
text: asked	the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources as mosquitoes may build up their resistance to the same type of chemical being used consistently, whether the alternating of chemicals is currently practised in fogging and, if not, whether the Ministry will review the current practice of fogging.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
text: Fogging is only a small part of the mosquito control strategy.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
text: Other actions such as diligently removing any potential sources of mosquito breeding are needed to protect our families from mosquito-borne diseases.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
text: I urge everyone to continue to do his part to keep the mosquito population in check.
